title: The observation request
description: Asks the running sketch to be observed. The writer places this atomically by way of a temporary file, and id changes with every request (ADR-0018 decision 3). With count at 2 or more, shots are taken in succession without stopping the frame loop, and the catalogue is written last.

id.description: This request's identifier. The reply echoes it back. A request with an id already seen is not processed again, even after the sketch relaunches: the answer left in the reply is the record. Do not reuse an id while the facet remains.

scale.description: How far to scale the written image down (1 = full size). 1 when omitted.

count.description: How many shots to take. 1 when omitted. Asking above the ceiling is never trimmed in silence: how many were cut appears in the reply's warnings.

every.description: Take a shot every this many frames. Every frame when omitted. **Counted in frames rather than seconds**, so the shots follow the frames the sketch actually draws. The sketch being observed runs on the wall clock, and writing the images makes frames heavier, so **the shots are not evenly spaced in time** — lay the series out by each entry's `time` in the catalogue (frames), rather than assuming an even gap.
